# PPR March 31 Release

_Category: Past Releases · Source: BC Registries API community forum_

**pheath** (3/31/2022):

**Ticket 11594** - When an amendment or discharge is completed for a registration, the Secured Party is to receive a copy of the verification statement. If the Registering Party is the same as the Secured Party, no verification statement will be sent to the Secured Party as the verification statement will be available on the dashboard of the Registering Party. If the two parties are not the same, a copy of the verification statement will be mailed to the Secured Party.
